summary.name: Altyst
summary.one_liner: Altyst is a paid web tool that turns a commercial property's listing link or underwriting documents (offering memorandum, rent roll, T-12) into an editable real-estate underwriting model with cash flows, IRR, and DSCR.
use_cases: Screen a commercial property listing before bidding
Extract figures from an offering memorandum and rent roll
Build a multi-year NOI and cash flow model
Size debt and test DSCR and debt yield
Run base, upside, and downside investment scenarios
Produce an Excel model, IC memo, and deck for an acquisition
summary.what_it_does: Altyst ingests a listing link or uploaded documents (PDF, XLSX, CSV) and uses AI to propose inputs, each tagged with its source and flagged for review when values conflict. A deterministic engine, which the page says runs in exact decimal arithmetic, computes gross rent through effective gross income to NOI, and then levered returns. Users can size debt by LTV, minimum DSCR, or debt yield, add mezzanine or interest-only periods, and model lease rollover with TI, leasing commissions, downtime, and renewal probability. Outputs include an Excel workbook with live formulas, a summary memo recommending proceed, reprice, or pass, and an editable PowerPoint deck or PDF.
notable: AI proposes inputs but a tested deterministic engine does the arithmetic, with per-figure provenance
Exports a live Excel underwriting workbook, IC summary memo, and PowerPoint deck
Covers multifamily, office, retail, industrial, self-storage, mixed-use, and land
Reprice to a bid that hits a target IRR in one click
caveats: Paid plans only: $12/mo (5 deals), $24/mo (15 deals), $99/mo (team, 75 deals), with custom enterprise pricing; extra deals cost $3 to $4 each
Scenario and sensitivity runs are carried in the Excel file as values, not live formulas
